title: Quarterly governance playbook for customer-hosted instances
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable quarterly governance and rollout playbook that operationalizes onboarding, upgrades, and risk controls for customer-hosted instances (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped). This ticket bundles the PM-level roadmap decisions, acceptance gates, and cross-functional cadence to drive Q1 cohort activations and Q2 upgrade windows. The playbook must balance safety (auditability, KMS integration, RBAC), speed (onboarding SLA), and economics (capacity tranche commitments).
acceptance_criteria: Stakeholder-aligned playbook approved by Eng, Security, and Solutions (signoff artifacts attached)
Wave schedule with gating criteria and measurable success signals for first 3 customer cohorts
Operational checklist (onboarding, preflight tests, post-install smoke tests) documented and linked to Console runbooks
Dependencies and rollback triggers enumerated; at least one automated canary rollout configured in Dedicated for parity testing
milestones: 2026-01-20: Draft playbook and initial stakeholder readout
2026-02-05: Security review and KMS/RBAC integration decisions finalized
2026-02-18: Pilot cohort wave plan (3 customers) and canary cadence defined
2026-03-08: Cross-team signoff and handoff to Solutions Engineering for execution
risks: Upgrade windows collide with customer maintenance windows — may force manual interventions and slow rollout
Insufficient telemetry on customer-hosted control plane in early waves — risk to SLA observability
KMS/HSM integration timelines could slip, delaying audit-ready activations
High variability in customer infra (network, proxy, egress rules) increases onboarding time per tenant
decisions: Use a two-phase onboarding: preflight (automated checks) + guided install (Solutions-led) for first two cohorts, then self-serve for later cohorts
Require KMS integration for any production-tier activation; development-tier can use a temporary managed key
Adopt 3-wave activation lanes: pilot (3 tenants), staged (10 tenants), broad (25+ tenants) — each wave gated by error budget and rollout metrics
notes: Trade-off considered: fully automated installer vs. guided installs. Chosen guided-first reduces early-failure blast radius at cost of manual SE time.
Ops cost estimate: 0.5 FTE Solutions Eng per 5 pilot customers for first 6 weeks.
We will map billing and metering back to customer tenancy IDs; finance needs a mapping table (see attachment).
